ticket.subject: Role does not give access to Reports
ticket.body_text:
Hey team,

We gave one of our team leads the Manager role, and they still get a 'no permission' message when opening Reports.

We tried removing and adding the role again.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Please tell us what we are missing.

Thanks so much!
Darius Okonkwo
customer success lead, Wrenfield Partners

label_notes: clean access (access-role-permission): a role problem for one user with others unaffected is P3; urgency medium: action needed this week.
